base.description:
{Gate Arch Devils}

Allows you to use Gating to gate Arch Devils.

Once cast, other creatures may also be gated.

H5 Synergy: if you have at least 4 stacks of H5 demons (not counting summoned ones) on the battlefield, summons the same number of H5 Arch Devils instead.
